evidence.head_shape: All six figures' visible faces read as round near-circles under their hair volume, consistent with base.png; hair bulk (afro, bun) makes the overall silhouette look taller but the face/head shape itself is round in every case.
evidence.no_nose_no_ears: Verified on close crops of all six faces individually: every figure shows only two plain dot eyes and a single mouth line. No nose bump/bridge/nostril on any figure, and no ear shape on any figure -- hair (or, for the bald figure, the smooth scalp/side-hair patch) fully covers the ear position in every case.
evidence.four_digit_hands: Checked both visible hand crops (figures 1 and 4-6 have hands clear of clothing): all show the simplified stylized mitt with finger-separation lines reading as three to four fingers plus thumb, consistent with the rig hand family; no five-digit realistic hand on any figure.
evidence.proportion: QUANTITATIVE MEASUREMENT (figure pixel height / head pixel width, via a throwaway PIL script measuring bounding boxes from top-of-head to bottom-of-feet against non-background mask, cross-checked visually with overlay boxes and crops): figure 1 (leftmost, light side-part) = 3.30, figure 2 (light-brown hair, skirt) = 3.91, figure 3 (dark curly hair) = 3.26, figure 4 (bald) = 3.37, figure 5 (light hair, white shirt) = 3.75, figure 6 (rightmost, bun) = 3.40. Demanded band is 3.0-3.5 squat with a hard ceiling of 3.9. 4 of 6 figures (1, 3, 4, 6) land cleanly inside the demanded band. Figure 5 sits above the demanded band at 3.75 (under the hard ceiling but visibly leaner-legged than the other four on direct crop inspection). Figure 2 measures 3.91, AT/marginally over the 3.9 hard ceiling -- this held stable (3.90-3.92) across five different background-distance thresholds (10/18/30/50/90), so it is not a measurement artifact; a direct crop of figure 2 shows visibly longer, thinner legs than figures 1/3/4/6. Ruling FAIL: the retry's stated goal was uniform squat proportion across all six figures, and this frame instead shows a real, verifiable spread from 3.26 to 3.91, with one figure breaching the hard ceiling.
evidence.flat_cel_render: Flat colour fills across all six figures' skin tones and clothing (shirts, sweaters, skirts, trousers) with only simple two-tone cel shading; no gradient/airbrush blending, no weave or mottled texture on any garment.
evidence.outline_consistency: Even outline weight is held across all six figures at their smaller on-canvas scale, with no figure missing outline on any part.
evidence.crowd_face_simplification: Verified via individual close-up crops of all six faces: every one carries the identical simplified crowd face -- two plain dot eyes and one simple neutral mouth line, no nose, no ears, no eyebrows, no teeth on any of them. No figure stands out as more detailed or individuated than the rest.
